One intermittent test failure (test_subscribe_public duplicate check) is caused by parallel pytest-xdist worker where TestBackup.test_import_round_trip wipes the newsletter collection between the two POSTs — verified manually that duplicate detection returns {ok:true, already:true}. No backend bug. Frontend: MAP BUG CONFIRMED FIXED — /immobili map-wrap now renders 18 real OpenStreetMap tiles with NO 'API KEY' text; property detail Posizione map renders 15 tiles. Property detail page has all testids present: pd-dot-0, pd-feat-0..5, pd-price-alert-btn, pd-unlock-plan-btn, pd-visit-btn, pd-wa, pd-phone — rich layout matches brief (gallery, RIF+status pills, big price, 6-card grid, Advisor note, Caratteristiche checklist, Iper-Potentini distances, Pre-Verificato shield, blurred floorplan with unlock, Posizione OSM map, sticky bottom bar). critical_code_review_comments: /api/admin/backup/import performs delete_many + insert_many WITHOUT a transaction. On partial failure or crash mid-import, collections can be left empty — consider wrapping in a Motor session with transactions, or at minimum validate the full payload before deleting.

/api/admin/backup/import accepts arbitrary documents from a client-provided file and inserts them raw — a malicious admin could inject documents with unexpected shapes (e.g., properties with fake 'ref_code' or users). Minor risk since admin-only, but consider per-collection pydantic validation.
server.py still blind-$sets request bodies in update_* endpoints for neighborhoods/poles/buyer-requests/properties (same comment as iteration 1 — unchanged).
NewsletterReq.email is a plain str; validator checks for '@' only. Consider pydantic EmailStr for robust validation (would also catch 'a@' or 'a@b').
Backup export .to_list(5000) is a hard cap — large tenants will silently lose rows. Add paging or raise cap with a warning.
Still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown — switch to lifespan context manager.

success_rate.backend: 100% (parallel race in 1 test is environmental, not a defect)

seed_data_creation: TEST_* newsletter emails and 1 testui_* email created from UI; a few TEST_ leads/buyer_requests remain from iter 1 — harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary iter-1 bug (map 'API KEY REQUIRED') is FIXED via OpenStreetMap tile provider in DarkMap.jsx. All new iter-2 features (light theme, redesigned property detail, backend backup, newsletter end-to-end) verified. If re-running pytest in parallel, be aware that TestBackup.test_import_round_trip DELETES then re-inserts the newsletter collection, which can race with concurrent TestNewsletter tests — either mark them serial or run newsletter tests before/after backup. Duplicate-newsletter detection confirmed manually.
rca of the issue: N/A — iter 1 map bug fixed; test_subscribe_public occasional failure root cause: pytest-xdist runs TestBackup and TestNewsletter on separate workers; TestBackup.test_import_round_trip calls POST /api/admin/backup/import which does db.newsletter.delete_many({}) + insert_many(exported). If this runs between TestNewsletter.test_subscribe_public's two subscribe POSTs, the first insert is wiped and the second returns {ok:true} instead of {already:true}. Mitigation: pytest.mark.serial these two classes, or scope newsletter tests to not run concurrently with backup.
